title: the detector: the held-out tetrode test of each decoder state, and the comparison with the Widloski & Foster detector on simulated replays

controls_continuing_sliding_one_per_part.description: continuing chains at the longest gap: share of trials the sliding window reports as one event per part

controls_continuing_sliding_spanning_sho.description: continuing chains at the shortest gap: share of trials the sliding window reports as one event over both parts

controls_elsewhere_ours_one_per_part_lon.description: the same at the longest gap

controls_elsewhere_ours_one_per_part_sho.description: chains whose parts are far apart, shortest gap: share of trials our detector reports as one event per part

controls_elsewhere_sliding_missing_min.description: chains whose parts are far apart: lowest share of trials, over gaps, in which the sliding window misses a part

controls_jump_ours_spanning_min.description: lowest share, over jump sizes, of two-part jump trials our detector reports as one event over both parts (pooled over 120 and 200 ms parts)

controls_jump_sliding_spanning_max.description: highest share, over jump sizes, of jump trials the sliding window reports as one event over both parts

controls_jumping_continuous_fraction.description: share of jumping bursts our continuous state alone covers

controls_jumping_nonlocal_fraction.description: share of jumping bursts our detector's non-local events cover

controls_jumping_sliding_before_test_fra.description: the same before its significance test

controls_jumping_sliding_fraction.description: share of jumping bursts the sliding window reports under the published definition

controls_multipart_trials.description: two-part trials over every jump and chain condition

controls_no_replay_minutes.description: minutes of simulated immobility with no replay; no output reported any event there

controls_no_replay_rate_bound.description: 95 % upper bound on the false event rate with none observed (the rule of three over those minutes)

controls_no_replay_recordings.description: simulated recordings the no-replay stretches come from

controls_ours_fewer_in_event_trials.description: trials in which our detector recovers fewer parts inside the event than alone

controls_ours_more_in_event_trials.description: trials in which it recovers more inside the event than alone

controls_ours_recovery_alone_fraction.description: the same with each part decoded alone

controls_ours_recovery_in_event_fraction.description: share of parts our detector recovers inside the event, the same mean

controls_placeless_continuous_fraction.description: share of place-less bursts our continuous state alone covers

controls_placeless_fragmented_share_max.description: highest share of a place-less burst's time in the fragmented state, over burst durations

controls_placeless_fragmented_share_min.description: lowest share of a place-less burst's time in the fragmented state, over burst durations

controls_placeless_nonlocal_fraction.description: share of place-less bursts our detector's non-local events cover, pooled over the three peak rates

controls_placeless_nonlocal_lowest_rate_.description: share of place-less bursts at the lowest peak rate, 20 Hz, our non-local events cover

controls_placeless_sliding_before_test_f.description: the same before its significance test

controls_placeless_sliding_fraction.description: share of place-less bursts the sliding window reports under the published definition

controls_sliding_fewer_in_event_trials.description: trials in which the sliding window recovers fewer parts inside the event than alone

controls_sliding_more_in_event_trials.description: trials in which it recovers more inside the event than alone

controls_sliding_recovery_alone_fraction.description: the same with each part decoded alone

controls_sliding_recovery_in_event_fract.description: share of parts the sliding window recovers inside the event, mean over jump and chain conditions and levels

sweep_shortest_start_early_ms.description: median amount the sliding window starts the shortest replays early

sweep_sliding_before_test_fraction.description: over the whole grid, share the sliding-window detector reports before its significance test

sweep_sliding_end_late_max_ms.description: largest median amount the sliding window ends late, over true durations

sweep_sliding_end_late_min_ms.description: smallest median amount the sliding window ends late, over true durations

sweep_sliding_end_late_upper_quartile_ma.description: largest upper quartile of the sliding window's end error, over true durations

sweep_sliding_fraction.description: over the whole grid, share the sliding-window detector reports under its own criteria, significance test included

sweep_sliding_not_the_replay_fraction.description: share of the sliding-window detector's accepted events that are not the replay put in

sweep_sliding_only_before_test_replays.description: the same, counting the sliding window's reports before its test

sweep_sliding_only_replays.description: swept replays the sliding-window detector reported and the state-space detector did not

sweep_sliding_spread_only_fraction.description: over the whole grid, share the sliding-window detector reports with the spread half of its significance test alone

sweep_sliding_start_early_max_ms.description: largest median amount the sliding window starts early, over true durations

sweep_sliding_start_early_min_ms.description: smallest median amount the sliding window starts early, over true durations

sweep_spread_half_pass_fraction.description: of the replays the sliding window reported before its test, share passing the test's spread half

sweep_state_space_edge_error_max_ms.description: largest absolute median start or end error of the state-space detector over true durations, replays both detectors reported

sweep_state_space_fraction.description: over the whole grid, share the state-space detector reports under its own criteria
